channel.title: The Center For Michigan | Bridge Magazine - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Center For Michigan | Bridge Magazine (thecenterformichigan.net)

item.title: Bridge Michigan News Quiz, Feb 27: Are you paying attention?
item.description: Following the news? Answer these questions and you could win a prize!

item.title: Study: Ann Arbor council most divided in nation — and that’s a good thing
item.description: A data company scoured 8 million meeting minutes nationwide over 17 years and concluded that Ann Arbor has the most dissent on its City Council. That makes for long meetings but good government

item.title: Can Michigan block new ICE facilities? How officials are fighting back
item.description: In Romulus and Southfield, local and state officials are battling a proposed ICE detention center and office space. They face an uphill fight.

item.title: U-M ends ties with program that helped diversify PhDs, after federal threat
item.description: The PhD Project was inspired by a U-M effort from the early 90s, but the university has ended its association with the mentoring program following a federal probe into ‘racial preferences.’

item.title: Report: Michigan to pay more for nursing homes than most of US — again
item.description: Amid concerns about the high cost of aging, new data highlights the increasing cost of nursing home care in Michigan and across the US.

item.title: Where Michigan Secretary of State candidates stand on key election issues
item.description: Votebeat asked Michigan’s secretary of state candidates where they stand on proof of citizenship, election security, and more.

item.title: Opinion | Protecting those who protect us: Restoring respect for Michigan first responders
item.description: Law enforcement officers and emergency personnel put their lives on the line every day, and they deserve to know that their safety is just as valued and defended as the communities they serve.

item.title: Jocelyn Benson pitches housing plan with homebuyer tax credits, Airbnb tax
item.description: Democratic gubernatorial hopeful Jocelyn Benson wants more tax credits for homebuyers, but also new taxes on Airbnbs and limits on home sales to private equity firms.

item.title: Reform expands savings program for Michiganders with disabilities
item.description: Special savings accounts allow people with disabilities to save money without triggering asset limits that otherwise stop benefits from Medicaid and Supplemental Security Income, or SSI.

item.title: Michigan paid consultants $2.9M for failed mental health redesign
item.description: Michigan paid McKinsey & Co. about $2.9 million to design a Medicaid behavioral health overhaul that a judge later struck down — hiring a firm the state had previously sued for its role in the opioid crisis.
